principle: Share the Airbnb platform-fee saving with guests and Les Buttes; use the previously agreed one-week both-cottage direct booking as the pricing precedent. Avoid a rigid public discount percentage or automatic formula.
priceBasis: Use comparable dates and real displayed nightly rates from the Airbnb host calendars; these are already adjusted for Airbnb's pricing change. Do NOT add Airbnb fees or apply unapproved holiday-overlay rates on top.

ownerQuotingPolicy.guidance: Aim for approximately 11% below equivalent Airbnb calendar accommodation-price total, but set a sensible rounded GBP quote for EACH cottage. The example rounds weekly guest offers to £50 increments. This is guidance, not a guaranteed customer discount, algorithm, coupon or automatic entitlement.
ownerQuotingPolicy.channel: Manual owner-approved direct quote, subject to full transparent terms and accurate fees.

actualDirectBookingPrecedent.note: These agreed prices supersede earlier hypothetical 8% or 10% pricing examples; preserve the booking at these amounts. This is not evidence of completed payment.

illustrativePlatformFees.note: Rounded figures. Actual Airbnb host fee, SumUp processing fee, cancellation exposure, dispute risk, taxes and any other charges require verification.
